Kuvuliwe / Yenza lube lula uhlaka lwesikrini futhi wenze umbhalo ufundeke kalula
Thuthukisa ukufaneleka kombhalo, futhi wenze lula uhlaka lwesikrini nokufuna

Ukuze uthole umklamo ohlanzekile kanye nohlelo lokucathuliswa olulula, iPixel ingadawuniloda ngokuzenzakalelayo ama-app abalulekile kanye namawijethi, ithuthukise uhlaka lwesikrini, ilungise ifonti, kanye nokuningi
Ngokuvala Ukubuka Okulula, idivayisi yakho izobuyela efontini, esibonisini, nakusethingi yesakhiwo sayo soqobo. Funda indlela yokushintsha lawa masethingi efonti ngayinye.
Ifonti yakho yamanje yinkulu kunamasethingi Wokubuka Okulula. Ukusebenzisa Ukubuka Okulula kuzokwehlisa usayizi wefonti yakho.
